title: BORMIOLI ROCCO .5L Glass Canning Jar, 1 EA
reviews_5s:
So far so good. Perfect size for chili crisp. Seems to seal really well and tight. Time will tell, but happy with my purchase.I'm only using this for dry storage, but it seals very well. It's easy to open and close as well. They're surprisingly heavy and feel very durable. I'll certainly be getting these again in the future.Nice size jar for the sugar cubes we keep on the bar for champagne cocktails. Very well made.If you're like me and mix several herbs like, ginger, turmeric and black pepper and other herbs and a need to air tight this mixture. This jar does the job, it has some weight, it's kind of thick glass and the seal is excellent...Bam..you welcomejust like fortnite

only downside is that it makes an ugly noise when you try removing the lid
that may just be on me not opening it right but im not sureGoodI usually use mason jars but I now am buying Fido jars as the lid is glass and it is better quality. Thicker glass with an attached lid, can’t get much better than this.These are a beautiful way to display my spice blends. Love the lid clamp which ensures the spice blends stay fresh!I did not realize that it would be this large however works great and I have not had any issuesThese are great jars. A little pricey but they work great and keep nuts and seeds fresh!
